calculation.description: Negative two-session cumulative residual return versus the cross-sectional median; higher values indicate idiosyncratic underperformance and expected next-session reversal, using completed data only.

validation.regime_notes: Positive in 2020-2022 (IC 0.04648, ICIR 0.13424), 2023-2024 (0.02985, 0.08497), and 2025-2026 (0.05887, 0.17237); conservative interpretation due to 15-name universe.
